notes.title: We Will Leave Early Access Soon!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
Panzer Knights will leave the early access on May 18 (PDT). At the same time, we will [i][b]reset save data[/b][/i] and [i][b]increase price[/b][/i].

As mentioned in the developer diary before, due to the new content and adjustments, the old saves will no longer be usable during major updates. Therefore, you need to delete the saves and start the game again. In terms of price, we will also adjust to [i][b]$24.99[/b][/i].

Thanks to the players who participated in the Early Access during this period and the development team for cooperating. It is really great to get players' feedback and support during the development process. The difference between the official version and the current version, in addition to the content mentioned in "Developer Diary #5" last time, we will also add Steam achievements. In addition, after the official version is released, there will be some free content updates in the future, including new side missions and new tanks, so stay tuned.

New contents in the official release:
[list]
[*]5 new missions
[*]Memoir of Crews
[*]New Skill of Crews
[*]9 usable tanks, including Tiger II, Jagdpanther, T34/76, T34/85, KV-1, KV-2, IS-2, 
B1, Matilda II
[*]Voices of bubble talk
[*]BGM in Battle
[*]Steam achievements
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.2.0 Released 4/7/21
notes.content:
update 0.2.0

Hello, Commanders,
The details of this version are as follows:
[h3][b]Main features[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New Missions: Road to English Channel, Operation Barbarossa ⅠⅠ
[*] Operation Barbarossa Ⅰ: adjust the number of friendly forces, wingmen, and enemy forces, add the countdown to failure in the final defensive object

[list]
[*] Optimized the pathfinding to avoid AI vehicles colliding with players
[*] When the wingman is too far away from the player, it will teleport to the player’s vicinity
[*] Fixed the damage of T-34
[*] Fixed the issue that the searching distance of S35 was too short
[*] Fixed Matilda ricocheting too easily when it was hit

[*] Fixed the determination of birth range to solve the issue that some enemies were not born
[*] The smoke add the effect that enemy's attack will have a high probability of missing
[*] Wingman formation: add parking command, V-shaped formation changed to wedge formation
[*] The turret has a chance to blow up when the vehicle is destroyed
[*] After the vehicle is destroyed, it will be removed under certain conditions after a fixed period of time
[*] New anti-tank gun: 2 pounder gun、M-37、Zis-2、Pak36、Flak36
[/list]
[h3][b]UI[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjust the main battle UI
[*] Add wingman avatar
[*] Added blinking animation to the main avatar of the character in battle
[*] Add new loading pictures
[/list]
[h3][b]Others[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added contents of the bubble in battle
[*] Add text speed option
[*] Add shadow quality option
[*] Add brightness option
[*] Added a switch to remove dead vehicles
[*] Added iron cross camouflage to the tank
[*] New object decorations for the tank
[*] Fixed the issue of the flickering and incorrect texture of some buildings
[*] Fixed the display issue of the character picture when the dialogue is switched quickly
[/list]
-Joybrick

notes.title: DEVELOPER DIARY #4
notes.content:
Hello commanders,

Since the last update, in addition to optimizing the original content, the development team has also been working hard to add new content. Some major changes are listed below:

[*] Two new missions
[*] Improve the situation of AI vehicles colliding with players' vehicle, and improve the issue of AI vehidle stuck

notes.content:
update 0.1.3

Commanders,
Since the last update, the team has not only continued to develop new content, but also adjusted and added some content in response to your feedback. The details are as follows:
[h3][b]Battle[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Increase the penetration of AP and APCR at long distances
[*] The damage of HE has been revised down and the range of damage caused by explosions has been reduced, and adjusted to not bounce
[*] When the caliber of the shell is 2.5 times larger than the enemy’s armor value, the chance of bounce can be reduced
[*] Adjust the probability of some speaking in battle
[*] Increase the vision and searching distance of the AI ​​tank
[*] Fixed AI tanks that can attack when they are outside their vision range
[*] Adjusted the Panzer II and TKS to the cannon version
[*] Added invalid mouse clicks within 0.5 seconds after the cut-scene dialogue ends to prevent accidental firing
[*] Try to fix the problem that the enemy does not appear in some missions
[*] Adjust deployment of Soviet army tank and wingman's models in [b]Operation Barbarossa Ⅰ[/b]
[*] Fixed part of the fence will block the shells in [B]Pass the Ardennes[/b] 
[*] Fixed the issue where the third crew member could not be displayed in the battle of Panzer II
[*] Fix some crash issues

notes.title: DEVELOPER DIARY #3
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

This diary will introduce the new contents that will be added in the future, namely the Camp and the Garage.

[h3][b]Camp[/b][/h3]
In the interface of the Camp, we can see the list of crews that can be owned in the game, and individual crew can be unlocked by accomplishing the medals of completing the objectives in the mission. Crew possesses basic skills that can give more advantages on the battlefield. Upgrading skills through medals can not only enhance the effect but also open additional effects at specific levels.

In addition, there will be special relationships between the crews, which we call bond characters. When passing the designated mission with the bond characters, you can also unlock unique dialogue content and skill.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711803/525e6897b4c10c9320465dace48ddcfd08ef508a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711803/347b9fe8a2ecbd42f1fb48521153be72a15a7507.png[/img]

[h3][b]Garage[/b][/h3]
And in the interface of the Garage, you can also see the list of tanks that can be controlled in the game, which can also be unlocked through medals. On the left side of this screen, you can see the various ability values ​​of the tank, set the crews of each vehicle, and decide which tank is ready to fight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711803/95e84e5d0f4d44afc824b0a422e852f7268383e1.png[/img]

In addition, you can see a tab called Camouflage, where you can unlock and switch the camouflage style of each tank. The camouflage has no effect and will not affect your performance in battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38711803/2f7110899f21cb78b357aa659dc0552130758486.png[/img]

By the way, we do not plan to design a fixed unlocking process or conditions. Therefore, if you are willing to repeat the previous missions, accumulate medals and directly unlock the tiger tank to crush the early enemy tanks, um... We are not against it!

[h3][b]Game Saves Reset[/b][/h3]
I need to say sorry to everyone first. Due to the development and game progress design, the player’s saves may need to be reset for major updates before the official launch, and the game must be restarted with a new game save. We will issue announcements for more information later.

Due to the development progress, we decided to update the contents of the new system mentioned above in order according to the progress of completion, and the details and balance of the contents will be revised continuously.

If you have any thoughts, please leave a message below to let us know, and see you next time.
